components.label: Coherence
components.intent: The repository-level reading surface: configuration, package contract, generated maps, and the authored explanation of why the harness exists.

components.label: Harness core
components.intent: Builds the source/spec graph, evaluates declared claims, renders reading surfaces, and records the decisions and observations that must survive an agent's context window.

gates.inv: agent lifecycle preserves decisions and exposes the current change signal
gates.oracle: hooks — generated wiring uses the low-cost entrypoint and observes writes

gates.inv: significant behavioral growth acquires an anchor or patch-specific decision
gates.oracle: only a zero-anchor alarm without attestation needs a decision

gates.inv: task context is bounded and names its approximations
gates.oracle: renderContext — byte-stable for the same inputs and names every approximation

gates.inv: cached decisions expose structurally expired premises
gates.oracle: audit — retracted decisions disappear and only broken strong leases fail a check

gates.inv: predicted context closure is calibrated against observed reads and outcomes
gates.oracle: calibration reports coverage, outside reads, and defect rates by prediction misses

gates.inv: reviewed risk sites survive relocation but never duplication
gates.oracle: sinks — a moved file keeps its baselined identity and a genuinely new site still fails

gates.inv: pinned mass follows a value-conserving rename but never absorbs growth
gates.oracle: mass — a renamed component keeps its pin; growth and novelty are never absorbed

gates.inv: a claim goes green only on positive evidence its oracle ran
gates.oracle: testMatch — a runner exiting 0 with no matching output FAILS (the renamed-test trap)

gates.inv: a vanished oracle reds its claim, never green-by-absence
gates.oracle: match — ZERO matching tests is its OWN state: the vanished oracle, named as such

gates.inv: a declared invariant unanchored by any boundary fails coverage
gates.oracle: RATCHET — a declared invariant with no anchoring boundary fails coverage

gates.inv: a via-test oracle that iterates no live domain fails its claim
gates.oracle: META-ORACLE — a `via test` boundary whose oracle loops a LITERAL fails

gates.inv: a skipped run never clobbers an oracle's recorded verdict
gates.oracle: merge — a skip never clobbers a real verdict; the old verdict rides through with its own stamp

gates.inv: a named oracle that no test runs cannot pass
gates.oracle: runner contract — a name that exists nowhere exits nonzero (the vanished oracle cannot pass)

gates.inv: an empty derivation against a remembered surface refuses, never passes
gates.oracle: FLOOR — an empty derivation against a remembered surface REFUSES, never reports coherent

components.label: Source adapters
components.intent: Translate language syntax and platform configuration into the common graph vocabulary consumed by the harness core.

components.label: Executable contracts
components.intent: Exercises the harness through focused unit contracts and end-to-end fixtures built from the same public data shapes that consuming repositories use.
